exposure: antenatal diagnosis of velamentous placental cord insertions
antenatal diagnosis of marginal placental cord insertions
outcome: Small-for-gestational-age birth weight (less than the 5th percentile)
cohort: 35,391 singleton pregnancies delivered after 24 6/7 weeks of gestation between January 1, 2012, and December 31, 2015, at a single Canadian tertiary care center
finding: Antenatal diagnosis of velamentous cord insertion is associated with an increased risk of small-for-gestational-age birth weight, cesarean delivery, and perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Velamentous cord insertion was associated with an increased risk of cesarean birth compared to pregnancies without this condition.
